title: Pre/Post-Assessment Cycles in Calculus: Supporting Student Preparation, Reflection, and Learning
summary: This article describes a semester-long implementation of pre/post-assessment cycles in an undergraduate Calculus I course. The activity was designed to address a common difficulty in lower-division mathematics courses: students often enter a new unit without knowing which prior ideas are relevant, which concepts deserve special attention, or how to judge their own progress before high-stakes exams. Brief pre-assessments were administered before major course units, and related post-assessment questions revisited key ideas after instruction. Students also completed short reflection prompts…
